description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to plugin metadata, including service states, channel states, subsystem information, and JSON serialization/deserialization for plugin components within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions for Service, Channel, Bridge, Minion, Server, MetaData, and SubSystem, along with enum conversions and operator overloads.

classes.name: MetaData::Service
classes.description: Represents plugin service metadata, including state, version, module, and interface information.

classes.name: MetaData::Channel
classes.description: Represents communication channel metadata with remote, state, activity, id, and name.

classes.name: MetaData::Bridge
classes.description: Represents bridge connection details such as locator, latency, model, and security.

classes.name: MetaData::Server
classes.description: Contains server thread pool and request statistics.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Main container for plugin metadata including subsystems, plugins, channels, bridges, server info, and versioning.

classes.name: MetaData::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages subsystem availability states within the plugin framework.

methods.name: MetaData::Service::operator=(const PluginHost::IShell*)
methods.description: Assigns service state based on the shell's state, including suspension/resumption logic.

methods.name: MetaData::Service::operator=(const MetaData::Service::State&)
methods.description: Copies service state from another instance.

methods.name: MetaData::Service::Data()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the service state.

methods.name: MetaData::Bridge::Bridge(const string&, uint32_t, const string&, bool)
MetaData::Server::Minion::operator=(const Core::ThreadPool::Metadata&)
methods.description: Maps thread pool metadata to Minion JSON structure.
